Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in comparing the magnitudes of subatomic particle masses. It incorrectly stated that $10^{-31}$ is a larger power-of-ten than $10^{-27}$ (claiming $31 > 27$ implies the former is larger), leading to the false conclusion that an electron is heavier than a proton. In reality, a larger negative exponent indicates a smaller number ($10^{-31} \ll 10^{-27}$). Consequently, the Planner concluded that losing a proton results in the least mass loss, whereas the correct answer is losing an electron, as it has the smallest mass by several orders of magnitude.
